jobs.title: Project & Program Management Consultant (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description
Project & Program Management Consultant II provides high-level administrative, operational support and project management to leaders and team members within Law & Regulation. This role serves as a key partner in ensuring the efficient execution of daily business activities through calendar management, meeting coordination, travel and expense administration, document preparation, communications support, and general office operations.

In addition to core administrative responsibilities, this position supports departmental operations, team initiatives, and project-related activities by coordinating information, tracking deliverables, preparing materials, and facilitating follow-through on key priorities. The successful candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage competing priorities while exercising sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Administrative Support
- Provide comprehensive administrative to a senior lead and team members within an assigned Law & Regulation functional area.

- Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings and events, reserve conference space, and oversee meeting logistics for both virtual and in-person engagements.

- Coordinate travel arrangements and prepare expense reports, invoices, and related documentation in accordance with company policies and budget guidelines.

- Manage and prioritize incoming communications, including calls, emails, mail, and shared mailbox inquiries, ensuring timely and appropriate follow-up.

- Draft, edit, proofread, and format correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.

- Prepare meeting agendas, organize meeting materials, capture notes as needed, and track action items through completion.

- Maintain organized records, files, and documentation while responding to a variety of administrative requests.

Operations & Team Support
- Support the day-to-day operational needs of an assigned functional area within Law & Regulation.

- Gather, organize, and maintain information, data, and supporting materials for presentations, leadership updates, reports, and departmental communications.

- Monitor shared mailboxes, triage requests, route inquiries to appropriate stakeholders, and assist in preparing responses to routine inquiries.

- Support matter management and document management processes, including intake coordination, document tracking, file organization, vendor billing, and collaboration with internal business partners.

- Assist with onboarding and team integration activities by helping new team members navigate department resources, processes, and tools.

- Project and program coordination.

- Contribute to special assignments, operational initiatives, and departmental projects as needed.

Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- 4 or more years of administrative support experience .

- Experience supporting senior leaders, legal, compliance, operations, or other corporate functions.

- Ability to work within a remote office environment, with flexibility to travel as required to support business needs.

Skills & Competencies
- Proficiency in MS Office Suite: Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Teams, Share-point and other business applications.

- Demonstrated administrative, organizational, and office management expertise.

- Strong calendar management and meeting coordination skills.

- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities.

- Exceptional attention to detail, including document preparation, proofreading, and formatting.

- Strong planning, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple competing demands.

- Ability to manage highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and commitment to follow-through.

- Ability to collaborate effectively across a matrixed organization and establish productive working relationships at all levels.

- Comfortable supporting both routine administrative activities and project-related work.

- Experience coordinating travel arrangements and processing expenses.

Supervisory Responsibilities
- This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Education & Experience (in lieu)
- In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Skills
Administrative Process, Administrative Support, Business Requirements, Collaboration, Detail-Oriented, High Accuracy, Leading Project Teams, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Windows Office, Operations Coordination, Project Coordination, Project Implementations, Project Management, Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC), Project Planning, Team Collaboration, Time Management

Compensation offered for this role is 60,000.00 - 97,125.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:

Job Description

Who is Allstate:

Allstate Insurance Company of Canada is a leading home and auto insurer focused on providing its customers prevention and protection products and services for every stage of life. Serving Canadians since 1953, Allstate strives to reassure both customers and employees with its “You’re in Good Hands®” promise and is proud to have been named a Best Employer in Canada for nine consecutive years. Allstate is committed to making a positive difference in the communities in which it   operates   through partnerships with charitable organizations, employee   giving   and volunteerism. To learn more, visit www.allstate.ca. For safety tips and advice, visit   www.goodhandsadvice.ca.

Through our Employee Value Proposition, we have worked hard to develop and nurture a culture where employees feel valued, experience personal growth, have career   options   and   truly enjoy   the work they do.

Benefits to joining Allstate

- Flexible Work Arrangements.

- Employee discounts (15% on auto and property insurance, plus many other products and services).

- Good Office program (receive up to $400 back after   purchasing   office equipment).

- Student Loan Payment Matching Program for Government Student loans.

- Comprehensive Retirement Savings Program with   employer matched   contributions.

- Annual Wellness allowance to support employees with improving health and wellbeing.

- Personal days.

- Tuition Reimbursement.

- Working within the community and giving back.

Role Designation:   Hybrid with a requirement to go into our Markham office once or twice a month.

Job Description

In this role, you will partner with business stakeholders to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive customer-focused and data-driven decisions across Operations. You will work at the intersection of analytics and business strategy—breaking down problems,   identifying   trends, and delivering clear recommendations that influence operational efficiency and performance.

You’ll   play a key role in a new and evolving space, supporting initiatives such as the launch and optimization of Allstate’s direct sales channels. By combining strong analytical thinking, storytelling, and technical   expertise , you will help shape how data is used to guide decisions, improve customer experience, and uncover new opportunities for growth.

Accountabilities :

- Analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple sources to   identify   trends, patterns, and key business drivers

- Translate business questions into structured analysis, delivering actionable insights and recommendations

- Develop dashboards, reports, and scorecards to   monitor   performance and support decision-making

- Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, align priorities, and provide consultative analytics support

- Assess performance against targets,   identify   variances, and recommend data-driven solutions to improve outcomes

- Forecast operational volumes and provide insights to support workforce planning and business strategy

- Build compelling data stories and visualizations to communicate insights effectively to diverse audiences

- Lead and deliver analytics projects of moderate complexity, including defining timelines, priorities, and deliverables

- Contribute to continuous improvement by enhancing analytical methodologies, processes, and reporting capabilities

Qualifications :

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and generate actionable insights

- Demonstrated experience working with data visualization and analytics tools   such as   Power BI   and   Adobe Analytics

- Proficiency   in Excel, including working with large datasets, pivot tables, and ad hoc analysis

- Ability to translate data into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences

- Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision-making

- Experience gathering requirements and working in a consultative, business-facing analytics role

- Familiarity with data querying or programming languages (e.g., SQL, DAX, or similar) is an asset

- Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment

- Curiosity and a proactive mindset, with a passion for exploring data and uncovering insights

Job Description
Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation.

The Sales Team

The Arity Sales team plants the seeds of our company’s success. We’re looking for candidates who bring a unique concoction of consulting, business development, technology, and—of course—sales experience to help our business take off. Innovation, transparency and a desire to do the right thing are essential for this position, because we’re not selling one specific product—we’re selling ideas and solutions we truly believe in. Team members are passionate about their job and excited about the opportunity to drive change not just for customers, but for an entire industry. Our ideal candidate has deep knowledge of transportation across multiple industries and thinks outside the box to help our partners solve their toughest transportation problems. Sound like you? Let’s chat!

The Role

The Arity Business Development Senior Manager is responsible for driving sales activity for Arity products and services across the Mobile Publisher and Automotive Manufacturer (OEM) segments to create and execute both short and long-term sales strategies.

In addition, the Business Development Representative will provide feedback from the market to influence Arity product and distribution strategy as well as go-to-market plans for Arity products that increase adoption of Arity’s technology and increase connections on the Arity platform.

Responsibilities

- Beginning and advancing sales discussions within target markets on Arity's products.

- Identifying and leveraging subject matter experts within Arity for sales discussions.

- Representing Arity at industry conferences and events.

- Gain a thorough understanding of Arity, its products and strategies.

- Works with internal teams to plan, implement and support strategic business plans and go-to-market strategies targeting the Mobile Publisher and OEM segments, with the goal of increasing adoption of Arity’s technology and increasing connections on the Arity platform .

- Contributing feedback and direction on sales messaging to product marketing.

- Identifies new markets or customers within the product verticals through feedback gained from the market.

- Coordinates with alternative distribution channels across the Allstate enterprise to work cooperative sales opportunities.

Required Qualifications

- Comfortable developing, closing and maintaining customers from the ground up

- Larger Enterprise Complex Sales Experience

- Strong business knowledge of SDKs and the OEM market

- Strong business knowledge of technology and software sales

- Proven track record for obtaining business results through the development of effective relationships within the distribution organization and across other business functions

- A deep understanding of all sales related functions

- Superior interpersonal and relationship building skills

- Building relationships and partnerships in business-to-business channels

- Ability to work within Product, Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Legal to get deals through the pipeline and closed

Preferred Qualifications

- 7 or more years of experience (Preferred)

- 4 year Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred)

At Arity, great things happen when our people work together.

That’s why when you join our team, we make sure it isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. And one where you can impact the future for the greater good .

You’ll do all this in a flexible environment that embraces connection and belonging. And with the recognition of several inclusivity and diversity awards, we’ve proven that Allstate empowers everyone to lead, drive change and give back where they work and live.

Good Hands. Greater Together.

jobs.description:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description
The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities
• Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability
• Delivers on the business unit’s annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director
• Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software
• Collaborates with Independent Agents to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results
• Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan
• Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and Underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market
• Consults with IA’s by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity
• Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies
• Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues
• Develops and maintains the assigned market’s new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level & coach new TSM’s

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Workday Compensation
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Lead Engineer to drive the delivery, support, and continuous enhancement of our Workday Compensation capabilities, including Core Compensation and Advanced Compensation. As a Lead Engineer, you'll serve as both a technical leader and people leader, providing day-to-day coaching, engineering oversight, and strategic direction for the Compensation product portfolio. You'll drive Workday configuration, feature delivery, annual compensation cycle readiness, production support, release management, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring a high-quality employee and manager experience.

The ideal candidate combines deep functional expertise in Workday Compensation with strong leadership skills, a product mindset, and a passion for delivering business value through technology.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing optimization of Workday Core Compensation and Advanced Compensation, and related technology applications.
